profile_text.body:
Netflix Inc is a publicly traded company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, trading under the ticker NFLX. On its own site, the company describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. It says members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. The site states that Netflix has over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

The harvested material does not describe any specific AI products or AI initiatives, and no products are tracked for the company in the record. Its stated position is that of an entertainment service spanning television, film, games and live programming rather than an AI vendor.

Among the facts held about the company, there are no lawsuits recorded and no MCP servers listed. The record notes a law exposure count of 281 in California. Netflix is a for-profit public company with CIK 0001065280.
